channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Business considering employing private security to patrol streets after attacks
item.description: Norwich bar Kerry's is looking into policing the streets themselves following a run of anti-social behaviour, says Marcus Pearcey

item.title: Swelling Broads community says it has 'reached its limit' as more homes approved
item.description: Villagers have warned Martham, a village in the Norfolk Broads, has "reached its limit" for more growth, as a further 50 homes have been given the go-ahead.

item.title: Norfolk man jailed for rapes more than 20 years ago has appeal bid refused
item.description: A man jailed for twice raping another man near a Norfolk hospital more than 20 years ago has had a bid to overturn his convictions refused.

item.title: Sex offender sent explicit message to 14-year-old girl weeks after prison release
item.description: Former Norwich bin man Jamie Overson who was previously exposed by paedophile hunters used a dating app to chat to a 14-year-old girl.

item.title: Work begins on new £360,000 foot and cycle path to make A149 coast road safer
item.description: Work is under way on a £360,000 scheme to make a path beside the busy A149 coast road safer for walkers and cyclists.

item.title: Barbershop flat plans given the green light by City Hall
item.description: Plans for a flat in the upstairs of a barbershop in the city centre have been given the green light by City Hall.

item.title: Spectacular displays attract national and international attention
item.description: A popular annual tradition that celebrates the wonder of Christmas in a Suffolk town has been hailed another stunning success.

item.title: Sugar factories revise completion dates as frost-affected beet harvest continues
item.description: British Sugar has updated the expected completion dates for the 2025/26 campaign as East Anglia's farmers continue bringing their winter beet harvest into factories.

item.title: Care company 'very sorry' after complaint about "laughing and joking" staff
item.description: A care company has said they were sorry after a man in his 70s raised a complaint about the service.

item.title: 'They are trying to make our country into the Netherlands' - fury at cycle lanes work
item.description: A major project to build cycle lanes and upgrade crossings on a road in a coastal town has been driving people in Gorleston mad.
